entities.title: The utv package API
entities.summary: The Python package utv 0.3.0: everything public is importable from utv and listed in utv.__all__.
consumers: This library's tests and example suites
guarantees: Distribution and import name utv; version 0.3.0 in pyproject.toml and utv.__version__.

The typed layer (0.3) and the JSON layer (0.1, 0.2 and the text form) are importable from utv and listed in utv.__all__; the JSON layer's functions are also in their modules (utv.build, utv.iso, utv.text, utv.ops, utv.zones, utv.native, utv.validate, utv.gregorian).
Reads and writes utv/1.0 values (utv.SPEC_VERSION); the JSON layer's results are utv-result/1.0; the text form is profile utv-text/1.
Total operations return values; partial ones return Outcome[T], the union of the frozen dataclasses Unique, Multiple, NoneOf, Unsupported and Invalid, each with diagnostics and __match_args__.
Typed values are frozen, slotted, hashable dataclasses, equal when their UTV JSON is equal.
Constructors raise OutcomeError, a ValueError carrying the status and diagnostics, for a value that can't exist; try_of returns an outcome; wrong Python types raise TypeError.
Parsing and the JSON layer never raise for bad input or a semantic outcome.
Diagnostic codes are those of docs/library-api.md §5; messages are free text.
Python's naming deviations: NoneOf for the none case; Period.of_days, of_months, of_weeks and of_years; TemporalContext(rules) and TemporalContext.with_rules(rules).
No clock, host time zone, locale, installed tz database or network access in library code.
entities.compatibility: Versioned with SemVer independently of the specification (VERSIONING.md) and still 0.x, so a minor release may change the API: 0.3.0 renamed the JSON layer's diagnostic codes and kept its functions and statuses. CHANGELOG.md records every change. Values labelled with another well-formed utv/ version are unsupported, never guessed at.
